en.21bb8e0e: This medicine is used for acute and chronic enteritis (bowel inflammation), acute and chronic diarrhea, acute dysentery, and abnormal intestinal fermentation due to various causes.
en.c0f13a5b: This medicine is used for acute and chronic enteritis, acute and chronic diarrhea, acute dysentery, and abnormal intestinal fermentation due to various causes.
en.d92e6421: This medicine is used for acute and chronic enteritis, acute and chronic diarrhea, acute dysentery, and abnormal intestinal fermentation due to various causes.
en.f1be4338: This medicine is used for acute and chronic enteritis, acute and chronic diarrhea, acute dysentery, and abnormal intestinal fermentation due to various causes.
en.a9ffddeb: Adults take 2 capsules per 1 dose, 3 times a day. For the first dose, take 4 capsules.
en.1563c23e: Adults take 2 capsules per 1 dose, 3 times a day, taking 4 capsules for the first dose.
en.0ea55d93: Adults take 2 capsules per 1 dose (4 capsules for the first dose), and children take 1 capsule per dose, 3 times a day.
en.6f522340: Children take 1 capsule per dose, 3 times a day.
en.719d1794: For infants, the capsule contents can be mixed into a small amount of water or milk.
en.edafc100: For infants, the capsule contents can be mixed into a small amount of water or milk.
en.b793c79a: Adults take 2 capsules per 1 dose, 3 times a day, taking 4 capsules for the first dose. Children take 1 capsule per dose, 3 times a day. For infants, the capsule contents can be mixed into a small amount of water or milk.
en.57fd1de1: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist for infants under 3 months old.
en.01d9bc5c: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist for infants under 3 months old. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
en.7b9d651d: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist for infants under 3 months old, or if you are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 5 or have experienced hypersensitivity to it.
en.88bef048: Do not take this medicine if you have hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.
en.76907cc5: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using ciprofloxacin, imipenem, or cilastatin sodium together with this medicine.
en.d339fa85: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using ciprofloxacin, imipenem, or cilastatin sodium together with this medicine.
en.f701ca47: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking ciprofloxacin, imipenem, or cilastatin sodium together with this medicine.
en.c1d98c90: Do not take this medicine together with ciprofloxacin, imipenem, or cilastatin sodium.
en.3f7b4084: If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about 1 month, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
en.4f764968: If symptoms do not improve after about 1 month of use, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
en.512658a1: If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for 1 month or longer, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
en.67902d25: If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
